recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned, 1970s-style portrait featuring a man in the foreground and a ghostly, translucent figure of a woman in the background within a cozy, wood-paneled living room. The scene is framed by a thick brown border with elegant serif typography at the top and bottom edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject in sharp focus vs. background ghost figure in soft transparency
Warm interior lighting vs. dark wood paneling
Text placement flush right at top and bottom edges
coreInvariants: Double exposure effect on the background figure
Subject wearing a turtleneck and suede blazer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject occupies the right two-thirds of the foreground, cropped at the waist. Ghostly figure is centered in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and eyes, which look directly at the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the man's face, down his jacket, across to the fireplace and the translucent woman, then to the text at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with detailed interior elements and the thick border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers (wood paneling, jacket, lighting)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high warmth; values are compressed into the mid-tones and shadows.

composition.position: Top right and bottom right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both name and title for consistency.
graphicDevices: Thick solid color border framing the central image

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s editorial serif look with high contrast.
Standard high-contrast serif that mimics the era's utility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s film-style photograph of a man with a beard, wearing a brown suede jacket and cream turtleneck, standing in a wood-paneled room. In the background, a translucent, ghostly double-exposure of a woman stands near a lit fireplace. The entire image has a warm, amber-sepia tint. Surround the image with a thick, solid dark-brown border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase italic serif text in cream color. Place the first line in the top right corner of the brown border and the second line in the bottom right corner of the brown border.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette restricted to warm browns and ambers?
Is the text right-aligned within the border?
Does the man have a 70s-style beard and hairstyle?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the warm color cast
mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain film grain
Do not use modern sans-serif fonts
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the border is a solid, flat color
Verify the text is high-contrast serif italic
Confirm the ghostly figure is properly blended
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a 70s-style portrait + apply amber/sepia filter + add a translucent double-exposure figure in the background + frame with a thick brown border + add right-aligned italic serif text.
